description: Product identity for CivicWorkDesk: one place for the names, publisher and store identity that packaging and store listings must agree on. The product version is NOT here; package.json#version is its single source. See docs/versioning-and-publisher.md.
publisherDisplayNameScope: Community builds published from the GitHub repository. Provisional: taken from the repository owner, not from a verified legal or signing identity.
storePublisherIdentityStatus: unresolved: must equal the verified developer, store and code-signing identity of each storefront before any store submission (Microsoft Partner Center, UnionTech developer platform, AppGallery Connect). Not invented here.
licenseStatement: Publicly readable source, all rights reserved.
runtimePrivacy: local-first, offline, no account, no cloud backend, no telemetry
